correctness.rationale: Classification of the surface and order-six MW group follows from Schütt--Shioda Section 9.5. F-nefness and adjunction show that negative curves are exactly the eleven fibre components and six sections. Section 11.8 torsion height calculations force sections to be disjoint and to meet components j mod n. The resulting exact integer 17x17 negative intersection matrix has been checked on every one of its 131072 principal index sets using the integer Bareiss algorithm and Sylvester/Schur tests. A second pass using 15 cyclic obstruction prototypes yields the same 72 minimal corank-one obstructions and the same support-size polynomial. Bauer--Funke--Neumann Proposition 1.1 converts supports to chambers. The Python code is a finite exhaustive certificate, not an assumption about arbitrary infinite families.

value.rationale: The fibre type I6+I3+I2+I1 is one of six classical semistable extremal rational elliptic surfaces and the one with a cyclic group of six sections. Its seventeen negative curves have a nontrivial triple-fibre incidence graph; 72 minimal singular submatrices fall into fifteen torsion orbits. The complete forbidden-support classification determines which negative parts of big-divisor Zariski decompositions occur and gives the exact naturally defined chamber invariant, not merely a small correction to a known table. No broader theorem or downstream application is asserted.
